description: This file defines the AdminModuleController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling administrative module routing and redirection in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It extends an abstract controller and includes a method to facilitate redirection to the admin module's default path.

classes.name: AdminModuleController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling admin module related requests and redirects.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the request and redirects to the default admin module path obtained from the HomePageService.
